Name: (CP) Offerings to Sleep
Author: reyphorian
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Behold, an offering.

[/size][/b][size=3]The Content Patcher of Offerings To Sleep adds various new furniture based on official artworks and visuals from the band Sleep Token, all available from a custom catalogue sold by Krobus. Decorate your home to represent your faction of Feathered Host or House Veridian, immerse  yourself into the deep sea, [/size][size=3]or show appreciation for the opening band of the 2025 Even In Arcadia Tour, Thornhill. Requires both Content Patcher and Calcifer.[/size]

[b][size=5][size=4][u][b]I do not allow[/b][/u][u][b] ANY[/b][/u] of my assets to be used in any generative AI program or Language Learning Model such as Midjourney or chatGPT. [b][u]DO NOT UPLOAD TO ANY AI DATASETS.

[/u][/b][/size][size=3][u]Please reach out to me if you're interested in making a translation![/u][/size]

[size=3][u][b]Disclaimer[/b][/u]: For potential concern by RICO and the RCA Records copyright team, this is mod was made to express appreciation for Sleep Token as my favorite band. I make no  financial profit off of this mod nor any of the assets used in it, and  have no intention to monetize this mod in any capacity.[/size][/size][/b][/center]
